acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Use a synthetic citing opinion with three references to the same authority:positive,contrast andexpress disapproval in a footnote. Record separate anchors,labels,quoted evidence,reasons andreviewer state. Compute any summary only under an identified taxonomy/version andapproved aggregation policy. Show the occurrence that drives the warning without deleting others. Test missing footnotes,duplicate references,changed source text andan unreviewed occurrence. A benign first match cannot silently suppress a later adverse one. A color alone cannot claim the authority is universally invalid.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Seed text containing distinction language about authority B while authority A is being followed. Require the proposed A/B relationship to show the relevant surrounding passage andtarget identity. Separately test sparse contrast,reasoned factual distinction,same-court repudiation andanother-court disapproval. Record jurisdiction,court,date andproposition scope;do not derive legal force from a color orword alone. For a statutory effect,link the actual statute/version andeffective date before any current-law conclusion. Ambiguous references remain unresolved for review. Automatic transcript examples do not supply verified case holdings.

workflow.output: Auditable assessment history andpolicy-bound current result

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Give two reviewers independent synthetic occurrence assignments under taxonomy v1. One selects a statutory-codification label withone warning level;another proposes a different level. Preserve both assessments,evidence,reasons andtaxonomy version. A supervisor resolution records its own basis without erasing originals or treating majority agreement as correctness. Updating v2 identifies affected summaries andrecomputes only under approved policy. Test a failed label dropdown:provide an explicit unresolved/draft recovery path,not a default benign label. Do not hard-code the training discussion’s disputed color choice as current law.

extensions.title: Treatment evidence andscope
extensions.test: Open a synthetic adverse-treatment summary andinspect every underlying occurrence,not just the first highlighted passage. Preserve exact source/version,date,court,classification reason andproposition scope. Test a later statute without verified statutory text:leave present-law status unresolved rather than importing the lecture’s legal conclusion.

extensions.title: Warning colors andcoverage are separate
extensions.test: Show label,severity,taxonomy version,corpus coverage andlast verification date separately. A disputed warning level stays reviewable;it cannot silently become a universal invalidity statement. Unsupported jurisdiction/time periods retain an open verification task.

extensions.title: Failed citation anchor recovery
extensions.test: Break a synthetic citation-linked highlight while keeping full text available. Show the intended cited authority andpassage/search fallback without claiming the highlight succeeded. Test browser search landing on an unrelated occurrence;require manual confirmation andretain the broken-anchor report.
